issue.description:
Admitted by the owner on 2026-11-01 (halfonadouble.com traffic review recommendation 7; evidence on halfonadouble.com epic hoad-a029ff53).

## Problem

The GA4 totals that estate-analytics collects for halfonadouble.com (property 557214664) are about 90% bot. From 2026-09-28 to 10-27 there were 10,203 sessions, of which **Singapore had 9,302 sessions with 7 engaged** (desktop Chrome, Direct, ~5,600 distinct landing pages, bursts on 10-13 to 10-16 and 10-23). Every dashboard or decision dataset that uses raw `sessions` (including the ga4-gates dataset) reports bot traffic as visitors.

## Scope

Add bot-filtered GA4 measures to the existing collector, dashboard and decision datasets. Do not build a second pipeline.
- Use a generic rule, not a hard-coded country: flag a (property, date, country, channel) cell as automated when its sessions are anomalously high and its engagement rate is about 0. Pick thresholds that flag the Singapore cells above and keep real low-volume countries. Document the rule and its constants in code and in docs.
- Lead with engaged sessions, and show "sessions excl. flagged automation" alongside raw sessions. Never drop raw data: flagging happens at read/aggregation time.
- Any GA4 gate in the ga4-gates dataset that uses sessions/pageviews uses the filtered figure.
- Optionally extend scripts/ga4-query.py with an `--exclude-automation` view.

## Acceptance

- Unit tests cover the classifier: the Singapore-like cells are flagged, and low-volume real cells (e.g. Canada at ~4 sessions/day with ~60% engagement) are not.
- The existing test suite passes. `cargo` is not involved: use the repo's pytest per its README.
- Bump VERSION; the image builds via the repo's CI and the tag is verified in the registry.
- Update the deployment pin in declarative-config (following this repo's existing deploy-bump pattern) and confirm the next collector run publishes the filtered fields.
- Record the before/after numbers for 2026-09-28 to 10-27 on this bead.
issue.notes:
## 2026-11-01 implementation + deploy (claude-interactive-hoad)

Rule (src/estate_analytics/sources/ga4.py): sum all sources in a (property, day, country, channel) cell; flag when sessions >= AUTOMATION_MIN_SESSIONS=10 AND 100*engaged <= AUTOMATION_MAX_ENGAGED_PCT=5 * sessions (integer math, identical in Python and SQL). No country list. Applied at read time via CLASSIFIED_DAILY_SQL (window over the cell); ga4_daily untouched. Documented in ga4.py, README "GA4 automation filter", plan Phase 8.
Datasets (publish.py): ga4-gates/ga4-traffic/ga4-countries lead with engaged_sessions, then sessions_excl_automation, page_views_excl_automation, automated_sessions, raw_sessions, raw_page_views. The bare sessions/page_views columns were removed so old readers fail loudly; no programmatic consumer exists (dashboard-site panel has no GA4 section; halfonadouble.com only has static JSON snapshots). ga4-gates compares sessions_excl_automation, page_views_excl_automation and tier1_sessions_excl_automation. ga4-countries is ranked by engaged. New ga4-automation lists flagged cells for 90d. meta.json.ga4_automation_rule. ga4-pages is unfiltered (no country/channel) and is documented as such. scripts/ga4-query.py report ... --exclude-automation.
Threshold calibration (live GA4, 377 cells): MIN 10 / 5% flags 25 cells (Singapore 9,325, Brazil 24 and Colombia 14 Direct on 10-19, all 0 engaged). Every other cell with >=10 sessions has >=20% engaged. MIN 5 would also flag 6-9-session zero-engaged cells (DE/CN/ID); MIN 15 would miss the 10-15/day Singapore baseline.

BEFORE/AFTER, property 557214664, 2026-09-28..10-27 (live GA4 pulled 2026-11-01; GA has revised up from the bead's 10,203):
- raw sessions 10,279 -> sessions_excl_automation 916 (automated 9,363 = 91.1%)
- engaged sessions 332 (lead figure)
- raw page views 11,284 -> 1,856 excl automation
- tier1 (US/UK/CA/AU) sessions 466 -> 466 (no tier-1 cell flagged); US 296/126 engaged, CA 131/81 kept whole
- Journey gate (1,000 sessions): raw falsely PASSED (10,279), filtered 916 = below the gate
- Singapore 9,338 raw, 9,325 flagged, 13 kept (days under the floor), 7 engaged

Verification:
- PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/ -> 61 passed (baseline 50 passed, no pre-existing failures; +11 new: classifier cases/boundaries, cross-source cell sum, sqlite SQL/Python parity, gate behavior, column contract, ga4-automation, meta rule). iad-ci test step also green.
- SQL run against throwaway Postgres 16.15 AND 18.6 (live cnpg-ardenone is 18.4) loaded with the live GA4 rows: ensure_schema idempotent, collect_datasets OK, SQL flags == Python flags (25 cells), figures above.
- Live run: scripts/ga4-query.py report 557214664 35 country --exclude-automation printed 32 flagged cells (9,988 sessions, 7 engaged) through 11-01.

(DOCKER_CONFIG built temporarily from OpenBao openbao-v2 secret/ardenone-cluster/docker-hub/registry and deleted after; ~/.docker/config.json no longer carries Docker Hub auth).
- declarative-config be7236d2b8f5414ffd583903c9886e1a1bbfed0f (k8s/ardenone-cluster/estate-analytics/deployment.yml 0.5.2 -> 0.6.0), pushed via throwaway worktree; merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main yes at 19:35 and 19:44 UTC.
- ArgoCD synced 19:43 UTC: deploy/estate-analytics image ronaldraygun/estate-analytics:0.6.0, pod estate-analytics-769c9c6d67-lchpw 1/1 Running 0 restarts; log "schema ensured; entering loop".

REMAINING (why open): no catch-up ran (last success about 14.5h earlier; CATCHUP_AFTER_HOURS=26). The first 0.6.0 publish is the scheduled run at 2026-11-02 05:00 UTC. To verify it: kubectl --server=http://traefik-ardenone-cluster:8001 logs -n estate-analytics deploy/estate-analytics should show "ga4: upserted ..." then "publish: wrote 20 objects" (0.5.x wrote 19; +ga4-automation), with no "publish: FAILED".
